overviewSection.heading: Connecting Communities with Quality Healthcare
overviewSection.text: KWETU CONNECT's Health Recruitment program bridges the gap between skilled healthcare professionals and communities in need. We specialize in recruiting culturally competent caregivers, nurses, and allied health professionals who understand the unique needs of diverse communities.
overviewSection.text2: Our comprehensive approach ensures that both healthcare workers and care recipients benefit from meaningful, sustainable partnerships that promote health equity and community wellbeing.
